preconditions.description: The input string must have a length between 1 and 100,000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of nonempty parts k must be positive and not exceed the number of output lines.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= len(stdin) and li > 0 for xi, li in parts)
postconditions.description: Each part must have a valid starting position xi and a positive length li.

postconditions.expression: sum(li for xi, li in parts) == len(password)
postconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of the parts must equal the length of the original password.
